title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11
source: Partial Set 3; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-Recorded by Bear (Reel # 4 Only); 1st Generation Cassettes(TDK SA-X 100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala; (Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer (Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing (iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard excerpt of a inspired Love Light performance – superb audio but only a brief fragment of the concert.
ai_review.review: The snippet captures a high‑energy segment of the show, highlighted by a soaring Love Light and a standout Jerry Garcia feedback solo. Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear sound quality, though they lament that only this short portion is available. Overall the musical performance shines despite the incomplete recording.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers praise the audio fidelity and the band's inspired playing; the only criticism concerns the missing remainder of the concert, not the quality of what is present.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear sound with no noted distortion or drop‑outs; reviewers describe it as “excellent sound quality”. The only drawback is the limited length of the excerpt.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a short segment is available, but within that window the band is described as “inspired” and having fun, with smooth transitions into the Love Light jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s feedback solo around the 18‑minute mark receives special praise.
